kitchen.note: The kitchen mini PC: mic, speakers and NFC in one box. No rooms key, so its replies stay on its own speaker.

master.note: Mic-only Pi in the master closet. The wake ding stays on its little USB speaker; spoken replies go out the master bath speakers via the broadcast chain. Timer alarms currently ring on the USB speaker too - moving those to the bath zone is the open half of the timer work.
